# Directive sample

Think step-by-step before you classify.
Think carefully about the quadrant.
Think hard about the reader.
Use step by step reasoning here.
Apply chain-of-thought to the receipt.
Show your reasoning in the response.
Explain the thought process behind it.
Walk through your thinking first.
Wrap analysis in <thinking> tags.
Take a deep breath before writing.

## Do

- Lead every directive with an active verb from the list.

## Do not

- Pad directives with filler words; cut them to the core action.
